name: Red Hat Enterprise Linux
install: ISO installer; free for personal development use via the Red Hat Developer Subscription
desc: RHEL is the distribution the RHCSA and RHCE exams are set on. A Developer Subscription is free for personal use and gives you the real thing rather than a rebuild.

name: Rocky Linux
install: ISO installer
desc: Rocky Linux is a community rebuild that is binary-compatible with RHEL, making it a free stand-in for exam practice.

name: AlmaLinux
install: ISO installer
desc: AlmaLinux is a foundation-backed, binary-compatible RHEL rebuild, the other common free choice for RHCSA labs.

name: Fedora
install: ISO installer
desc: Fedora is Red Hat's upstream community distribution, useful for seeing where RHEL features are heading.

name: Debian
install: ISO installer
desc: Debian is a stable, widely deployed general-purpose distribution and the base for many others.

name: Ubuntu Server
install: ISO installer
desc: Ubuntu Server is the most common Linux target in cloud images and a frequent choice for self-hosting labs.

name: FreeBSD
install: ISO installer
desc: FreeBSD is a complete Unix-like operating system developed as a single coherent base, used heavily in networking and storage appliances.

name: OpenBSD
install: ISO installer
desc: OpenBSD is a Unix-like system with a strong focus on correctness and security, and the origin of OpenSSH and PF.

name: Cockpit
install: dnf install cockpit
desc: Cockpit is a browser-based administration console for Linux servers, covering services, storage, networking and logs. It ships with RHEL and is worth knowing for RHCSA.

name: Ansible
install: pip install ansible  or  dnf install ansible-core
desc: Ansible is the agentless automation tool the current RHCE exam is built around. The control node is Linux-only, so run it from a lab VM or WSL.

name: AWX
install: Deploy with the AWX Operator on Kubernetes
desc: AWX is the upstream open-source project behind Ansible Automation Platform's web UI, API, and job scheduling.

name: Docker Engine
install: Follow the distribution instructions in the upstream docs
desc: Docker Engine is the container runtime and daemon on Linux hosts, as distinct from Docker Desktop on a workstation.

name: Kubernetes
install: kubeadm, k3s, or a managed cloud service
desc: Kubernetes is the container orchestration platform the CKA, CKAD and CKS exams are set on. Practise against a real cluster, not only a local one.

name: Rancher
install: Helm chart or Docker
desc: Rancher manages multiple Kubernetes clusters from one control plane, with centralised authentication and policy.

name: Portainer
install: Docker container
desc: Portainer is a lightweight web UI for managing Docker and Kubernetes environments, popular in home labs.

name: Prometheus
install: Binary release, Docker, or Helm
desc: Prometheus is the de facto open-source metrics and alerting system, scraping time-series data from instrumented targets.

name: Grafana Loki
install: Docker or Helm
desc: Loki is a log aggregation system designed to index labels rather than full log text, pairing with Grafana for queries.

name: Graylog
install: Docker, or distribution packages
desc: Graylog is a centralised log management platform with parsing, search, dashboards and alerting.

name: Elasticsearch
install: Docker, or distribution packages
desc: Elasticsearch is the search and analytics engine underpinning the ELK stack, widely used for log and security analytics.

name: OpenSearch
install: Docker Compose, distribution packages or Helm chart
desc: OpenSearch is a Linux Foundation search and analytics engine forked from Elasticsearch 7.10, with OpenSearch Dashboards for log and security analytics.

name: Uptime Kuma
install: Docker container
desc: Uptime Kuma is a self-hosted uptime monitor with status pages and a wide range of notification channels.

name: Cisco Packet Tracer
install: Free download, but only through a Cisco Networking Academy account
desc: Packet Tracer is Cisco's network simulator and the standard CCNA study tool. There is no public package: you must register with Networking Academy to download it.

name: GNS3
install: Vendor installer from gns3.com
desc: GNS3 emulates real network topologies using actual device images and containers, going well beyond what a simulator can model. You supply your own licensed IOS images.

name: EVE-NG
install: Import the OVA into a hypervisor
desc: EVE-NG is a clientless network emulation platform you run as a virtual appliance, used for large multi-vendor lab topologies.

name: Containerlab
install: Install script, or distribution packages
desc: Containerlab builds network topologies from containerised routing images declaratively, a modern alternative to GUI emulators for automation practice.

name: pfSense
install: ISO installer on dedicated hardware or a VM
desc: pfSense is a FreeBSD-based firewall and router distribution with VPN, traffic shaping and a web interface.

name: OPNsense
install: ISO installer on dedicated hardware or a VM
desc: OPNsense is a FreeBSD-based firewall platform, forked from pfSense, with a strong release cadence and plugin system.

name: VyOS
install: ISO installer; rolling builds are free
desc: VyOS is a Linux-based network operating system with a unified CLI, useful for practising routing configuration without vendor hardware.

name: MikroTik RouterOS
install: Vendor download; CHR runs free in a VM with a speed limit
desc: RouterOS is MikroTik's router operating system. The Cloud Hosted Router image runs in a VM, so you can practise real routing and firewalling cheaply.

name: LibreNMS
install: Docker, or a server install
desc: LibreNMS is an auto-discovering network monitoring system using SNMP, with alerting and multi-vendor support.

name: Nagios Core
install: Source build, or distribution packages
desc: Nagios Core is a long-established host and service monitoring system built around check plugins.

name: Zabbix Server
install: Distribution packages, or Docker
desc: Zabbix is an enterprise monitoring platform for networks, servers and applications. The Windows agent in this directory reports to a server like this one.

name: NetBox
install: Docker, or a server install
desc: NetBox is the standard open-source source of truth for network documentation: IPAM, racks, circuits, devices and cabling.

name: phpIPAM
install: Docker, or a PHP web server
desc: phpIPAM is a lightweight, web-based IP address management tool with subnet scanning and VLAN tracking.

name: Asterisk
install: Source build, or distribution packages
desc: Asterisk is the open-source telephony engine behind a great many VoIP and SIP deployments.

name: FreePBX
install: ISO installer, or on top of an existing Asterisk host
desc: FreePBX is a web configuration layer over Asterisk, turning it into a manageable PBX for VoIP labs.

name: Kali Linux
install: ISO, VM image, or WSL
desc: Kali is the penetration-testing distribution that bundles the toolset most offensive-security courses assume. Running it as a VM is how you get Metasploit, sqlmap, hashcat and the rest on a Windows machine.

name: Parrot Security OS
install: ISO, or VM image
desc: Parrot Security is a Debian-based security distribution, an alternative to Kali with a lighter desktop and a privacy focus.

name: Security Onion
install: ISO installer
desc: Security Onion is a monitoring distribution that bundles Suricata, Zeek, Elasticsearch and Kibana into a working network security monitoring stack.

name: REMnux
install: VM appliance, or an install script on Ubuntu
desc: REMnux is a Linux toolkit curated for reverse-engineering and analysing malicious software.

name: Tails
install: Write the image to a USB stick
desc: Tails is an amnesic live operating system that routes traffic through Tor and leaves no trace on the host disk.

name: Qubes OS
install: ISO installer on supported hardware
desc: Qubes OS enforces security by compartmentalising your work into separate virtual machines by trust level.

name: Metasploit Framework
install: Bundled with Kali, or the vendor installer
desc: Metasploit is the standard exploitation and post-exploitation framework. Use it only against systems you own or are authorised in writing to test.

name: Ghidra
install: Download the release archive and run; requires a JDK
desc: Ghidra is the NSA's software reverse-engineering suite, with a decompiler that made serious binary analysis free. It runs on Windows but ships as an archive, not a package.

name: hashcat
install: Download the release archive; needs GPU drivers
desc: hashcat is a GPU-accelerated password recovery tool used for auditing password strength against recovered hashes. Audit only hashes you are authorised to test.

name: John the Ripper
install: Bundled with Kali, or build from source
desc: John the Ripper is a long-standing password-cracking tool used for auditing weak credentials.

name: sqlmap
install: git clone, or pip
desc: sqlmap automates detection and exploitation of SQL injection flaws. Point it only at applications you are authorised to test.

name: Nikto
install: git clone, or distribution packages
desc: Nikto is a web server scanner that checks for dangerous files, outdated versions and configuration problems.

name: THC Hydra
install: Bundled with Kali, or build from source
desc: Hydra is a parallelised network login cracker supporting many protocols, used to demonstrate weak credential policies in authorised tests.

name: Aircrack-ng
install: Bundled with Kali, or the vendor build
desc: Aircrack-ng is a suite for assessing Wi-Fi network security, covering capture, analysis and key recovery. Test only networks you own.

name: Responder
install: git clone; bundled with Kali
desc: Responder is an LLMNR, NBT-NS and MDNS poisoner used in authorised internal assessments to demonstrate credential-relay exposure.

name: Impacket
install: pip install impacket
desc: Impacket is a collection of Python classes for working with network protocols, widely used for Windows and Active Directory testing.

name: BloodHound
install: Docker Compose for the server; collectors run on the domain
desc: BloodHound maps Active Directory attack paths as a graph, used by both red teams and the AD administrators hardening against them.

name: Greenbone / OpenVAS
install: Docker, or the Greenbone Community appliance
desc: Greenbone Vulnerability Management, built on the OpenVAS scanner, is the main open-source alternative to commercial vulnerability scanners.

name: Lynis
install: git clone, or distribution packages
desc: Lynis audits the security configuration of a Unix-like host and reports hardening suggestions with references.

name: OpenSCAP
install: dnf install openscap-scanner scap-security-guide
desc: OpenSCAP evaluates a system against SCAP security policies such as CIS and DISA STIG baselines, and ships in RHEL.

name: TheHive
install: Docker images or Linux packages from StrangeBee; the free Community licence limits users and some features
desc: TheHive is a security incident response platform for case management and collaborative investigation, often paired with MISP; TheHive 4, the last AGPL release, is end-of-life.

name: MISP
install: Docker, or an install script
desc: MISP is a threat intelligence platform for storing, correlating and sharing indicators of compromise.

name: Volatility 3
install: pip install volatility3
desc: Volatility is the memory-forensics framework for extracting processes, network state and injected code from RAM captures. The Windows GUI in this directory wraps it.

name: CyberChef
install: Use the hosted page, or serve the static build yourself
desc: CyberChef is a browser-based tool for encoding, decoding, parsing and analysing data, invaluable for CTFs and incident triage.

name: Semgrep
install: pip install semgrep, or Docker
desc: Semgrep is a fast static analysis tool for finding security bugs and enforcing code standards using pattern rules.

name: Prowler
install: pip install prowler
desc: Prowler audits AWS, Azure, GCP and Kubernetes against security best practice and compliance benchmarks.

name: ScoutSuite
install: pip install scoutsuite
desc: ScoutSuite is a multi-cloud security auditing tool that produces an offline HTML report of configuration risk.

name: Zeek
install: Distribution packages, or build from source
desc: Zeek (formerly Bro) turns network traffic into rich structured logs rather than alerts, the backbone of serious network security monitoring.

name: Snort
install: Vendor installer, or distribution packages
desc: Snort is a signature-based intrusion detection and prevention system maintained by Cisco, with community and subscriber rule sets.

name: Proxmox VE
install: ISO installer on bare metal
desc: Proxmox VE is a bare-metal hypervisor combining KVM virtual machines and LXC containers with clustering and backups, the usual choice for a serious home lab.

name: TrueNAS
install: ISO installer on bare metal
desc: TrueNAS is a storage operating system built on ZFS, providing NAS and SAN services with snapshots and replication.

name: OpenMediaVault
install: ISO installer, or a script on Debian
desc: OpenMediaVault is a Debian-based NAS solution with a web interface and a plugin system, lighter than TrueNAS for small setups.

name: Nginx
install: Distribution packages, or the official repository
desc: Nginx is a high-performance web server, reverse proxy and load balancer, and one of the two servers most of the web runs on.

name: Apache HTTP Server
install: Distribution packages (httpd or apache2)
desc: The Apache HTTP Server is the long-established modular web server, and the one RHCSA-track material usually configures.

name: HAProxy
install: Distribution packages
desc: HAProxy is a reliable, high-performance TCP and HTTP load balancer used in front of large deployments.

name: Traefik
install: Binary, Docker, or Helm
desc: Traefik is a reverse proxy that discovers services automatically from Docker or Kubernetes and handles TLS certificates for them.

name: Certbot
install: Distribution packages, or snap
desc: Certbot obtains and renews free Let's Encrypt TLS certificates and can configure your web server to use them.

name: BIND 9
install: Distribution packages (bind or named)
desc: BIND is the reference DNS server implementation, still the standard way to learn authoritative and recursive DNS properly.

name: PowerDNS
install: Distribution packages
desc: PowerDNS is a DNS server with pluggable database backends and a separate recursor, common in hosting environments.

name: Technitium DNS Server
install: Installer, Docker, or .NET build
desc: Technitium is a self-hostable DNS server with ad blocking, DoH and DoT support and a clear web interface, approachable for a home lab.

name: Mailcow
install: Docker Compose
desc: Mailcow is a dockerised mail server suite bundling Postfix, Dovecot, Rspamd and a web UI. Running mail well is hard; this makes it tractable.

name: Mail-in-a-Box
install: Install script on a clean Ubuntu host
desc: Mail-in-a-Box turns a fresh Ubuntu server into a working mail server with DNS, webmail and spam filtering in one script.

name: Coolify
install: Install script, or Docker
desc: Coolify is a self-hostable deployment platform, an open alternative to Heroku-style hosting for your own server.

name: Dokku
install: Install script on a Linux host
desc: Dokku is a minimal single-host platform-as-a-service built on Docker, deploying apps with a git push.

name: CapRover
install: Docker on a fresh host
desc: CapRover is a self-hosted PaaS with a web UI, one-click app store and automatic TLS, built on Docker Swarm.

name: HestiaCP
install: Install script on Debian or Ubuntu
desc: Hestia Control Panel is a lightweight open-source web hosting panel covering web, mail, DNS and databases.

name: CyberPanel
install: Install script on a supported distribution
desc: CyberPanel is a hosting control panel built on OpenLiteSpeed, with staging, backups and one-click WordPress.

name: Authentik
install: Docker Compose, or Helm
desc: Authentik is a self-hosted identity provider supporting SAML, OAuth2 and LDAP, giving single sign-on to your own services.

name: Keycloak
install: Docker, or a distribution build
desc: Keycloak is Red Hat's open-source identity and access management server, handling SSO, federation and fine-grained authorisation.

name: BorgBackup
install: Distribution packages, or pip
desc: Borg is a deduplicating, compressing, encrypted backup program for Unix-like systems, frequently paired with Borgmatic for scheduling.

name: Clonezilla
install: Write the live image to a USB stick
desc: Clonezilla is a bootable disk and partition imaging tool for bare-metal backup, restore and mass deployment.

name: GParted
install: Live USB image, or distribution packages
desc: GParted is a graphical partition editor, usually run from its live image to resize or repair partitions a running OS cannot touch.

name: OpenProject
install: Docker, or distribution packages
desc: OpenProject is a self-hosted project management suite with work packages, Gantt charts, agile boards and time tracking.

name: Redmine
install: Docker, or a Rails deployment
desc: Redmine is a long-established issue tracker and project management application with per-project wikis and forums.

name: Taiga
install: Docker Compose
desc: Taiga is an agile project management tool built around Scrum and Kanban workflows.

name: Vikunja
install: Docker, or a single binary
desc: Vikunja is a self-hosted task and project manager with list, Gantt, table and Kanban views.

name: Plane
install: Docker Compose
desc: Plane is an open-source project planning tool covering issues, cycles and modules, positioned as a Jira alternative.

name: Wekan
install: Docker, or snap
desc: Wekan is an open-source Kanban board, a straightforward self-hosted stand-in for Trello.

name: CentOS Stream
install: ISO installer, or a cloud/Vagrant image
desc: CentOS Stream is the continuously delivered distribution just upstream of RHEL, so it previews the next RHEL minor release.

name: openSUSE Leap
install: ISO installer
desc: openSUSE Leap is a stable community distribution that shares its core with SUSE Linux Enterprise, with YaST and Btrfs snapshots by default.

name: Arch Linux
install: ISO installer, then the guided `archinstall` script or a manual install following the wiki
desc: Arch Linux is a minimal rolling-release distribution that you build up yourself, and its wiki is one of the best Linux references anywhere.

name: Alpine Linux
install: ISO installer, or the `alpine` container image
desc: Alpine Linux is a small, security-oriented distribution built on musl and BusyBox, and the most common base for container images.

name: NixOS
install: ISO installer; the Nix package manager also runs on other distributions and under WSL
desc: NixOS is a distribution configured declaratively from a single file, so a whole system can be rebuilt, rolled back or reproduced exactly.

name: Webmin
install: Add the official repository with the setup script from the download page, then install with `dnf` or `apt`
desc: Webmin is a long-standing web interface for administering Unix-like systems, covering users, packages, services, the firewall and many server daemons.

name: OpenWrt
install: Firmware image for a supported router, or an x86-64 image to run as a VM in a lab
desc: OpenWrt is a Linux distribution for routers that replaces vendor firmware with a full package-managed system with firewall, VLAN and VPN support.

name: Pi-hole
install: The official installer script, or the official Docker image
desc: Pi-hole is a network-wide DNS sinkhole that blocks advertising and tracking domains for every device on the network, with a query log and dashboard.

name: Unbound
install: Distribution package
commands: sudo dnf install unbound   # RHEL / Fedora
sudo apt install unbound   # Debian / Ubuntu
desc: Unbound is a validating, recursive and caching DNS resolver, and the usual choice for running your own DNSSEC-validating resolver.

name: ntopng
install: Packages from the ntop repository (Community edition)
desc: ntopng is a web-based traffic monitor that breaks down flows by host, application and protocol from a mirror port or NetFlow/sFlow exports.

name: SmokePing
install: Distribution package, or the official Docker image
desc: SmokePing measures latency and packet loss to many targets over time and graphs the jitter, which makes intermittent network problems visible.

name: Kea DHCP
install: ISC packages or distribution packages
desc: Kea is ISC's modern DHCPv4 and DHCPv6 server, the successor to ISC DHCP, with JSON configuration and a REST API.

name: FRRouting
install: Distribution packages or the FRR repository; also runs in Containerlab topologies
desc: FRRouting is an IP routing suite for Linux that implements BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, RIP and more behind a Cisco-like CLI, which makes it ideal for routing labs.

name: Cacti
install: Distribution package or the release tarball on a LAMP stack
desc: Cacti polls devices over SNMP and graphs interface and resource usage with RRDtool.

name: Netmiko
install: Python package
desc: Netmiko is a Python library that simplifies SSH sessions to network devices from Cisco, Juniper, Arista and many other vendors.

name: NAPALM
install: Python package
desc: NAPALM provides a vendor-neutral Python API for reading state from network devices and pushing configuration to them.

name: Nornir
install: Python package
desc: Nornir is a pure-Python automation framework that runs tasks concurrently across a network inventory, usually with Netmiko or NAPALM plugins.

name: Wazuh
install: All-in-one installation assistant, OVA or Docker; the Windows agent has its own card
desc: Wazuh is an open-source SIEM and XDR platform that combines log analysis, file integrity monitoring, vulnerability detection and compliance reporting.

name: CrowdSec
install: Official repository packages or Docker, plus a bouncer for your firewall or proxy
desc: CrowdSec detects aggressive behaviour in service logs and blocks offending IPs through bouncers, sharing signals in a crowd-sourced blocklist.

name: OWASP Dependency-Track
install: Docker Compose bundle from the project
desc: Dependency-Track ingests SBOMs and continuously checks the components in them against vulnerability databases and licence policy.

name: Falco
install: Helm chart for Kubernetes, or distribution packages for a single host
desc: Falco is a CNCF runtime-security tool that watches kernel system calls and alerts on suspicious behaviour in hosts and containers.

name: kube-bench
install: Run as a Kubernetes Job from the project's manifests, or as a binary on a node
desc: kube-bench checks whether a Kubernetes cluster is deployed according to the CIS Kubernetes Benchmark.

name: Checkov
install: Python package, or the official Docker image
desc: Checkov scans Terraform, CloudFormation, Kubernetes, Helm and Dockerfiles for security misconfigurations before deployment.

name: Plaso
install: Official Docker image or distribution packages
desc: Plaso (log2timeline) extracts timestamps from disk images and logs into a single super-timeline for forensic analysis.

name: Arkime
install: Packages from the project, backed by OpenSearch or Elasticsearch
desc: Arkime is a large-scale full packet capture and indexing system with a web interface for searching sessions and exporting PCAP.

name: OpenCTI
install: Docker Compose deployment from the project
desc: OpenCTI is a threat-intelligence platform that stores and links indicators, threat actors and campaigns using the STIX 2.1 model.

name: MITRE Caldera
install: Clone the repository and run the server, or use the Docker image
desc: Caldera is MITRE's adversary-emulation platform for running automated, ATT&CK-mapped operations to test your defences.

name: Atomic Red Team
install: Clone the test library; the Invoke-AtomicRedTeam PowerShell module runs the tests
desc: Atomic Red Team is a library of small ATT&CK-mapped tests that you run to check whether your detections actually fire.

name: OWASP Amass
install: Release binary, Go install or Docker image; preinstalled on Kali
desc: Amass maps an organisation's external attack surface by enumerating subdomains and related assets from many data sources.

name: Gobuster
install: Release binary or Go install; preinstalled on Kali
desc: Gobuster brute-forces URIs, DNS subdomains, virtual hosts and cloud buckets from a wordlist.

name: Nuclei
install: Release binary, Go install or Docker image
desc: Nuclei sends template-driven requests to find known vulnerabilities and misconfigurations across many hosts quickly.

name: OWASP Juice Shop
install: Official Docker image, run on your own machine only
desc: OWASP Juice Shop is a deliberately insecure web shop for practising web-application attacks legally, covering the OWASP Top 10 and more.

name: DVWA
install: Docker image or a local LAMP stack; never expose it to a network
desc: Damn Vulnerable Web Application is a deliberately vulnerable PHP/MySQL app with adjustable difficulty, used for practising common web attacks.

name: OpenStack
install: DevStack for a single-node lab; Kolla-Ansible or a vendor distribution for production
desc: OpenStack is the open-source cloud platform for running compute, networking and storage as an on-premises IaaS.

name: Apache CloudStack
install: Management server and agent packages from the project
desc: Apache CloudStack is an IaaS platform that manages KVM, VMware and XenServer hosts as a single multi-tenant cloud.

name: Garage
install: Single static binary or Docker image
desc: Garage is a lightweight, geo-distributed S3-compatible object store designed for self-hosting on modest hardware.

name: SeaweedFS
install: Release binary, Docker image or Helm chart
desc: SeaweedFS is a distributed file and object store with an S3 API, built to handle very large numbers of small files.

name: AWS CDK
install: npm package; needs Node.js, which has its own card
desc: The AWS Cloud Development Kit defines AWS infrastructure in TypeScript, Python, Java, C# or Go and synthesises it to CloudFormation.

name: Wrangler
install: npm package, installed per project
desc: Wrangler is Cloudflare's CLI for developing, testing and deploying Workers and Pages along with their storage bindings.

name: Gitea
install: Single binary, Docker image or Helm chart
desc: Gitea is a lightweight self-hosted Git service with pull requests, issues, a package registry and Actions-compatible CI.

name: Forgejo
install: Single binary or Docker image
desc: Forgejo is a community-governed fork of Gitea that provides self-hosted Git hosting, issues, pull requests and Actions-style CI.

name: GitLab Community Edition
install: Omnibus Linux package, Docker image or Helm chart
desc: GitLab CE is a self-hosted DevOps platform with Git hosting, merge requests, CI/CD pipelines, a container registry and issue tracking.

name: Harbor
install: Helm chart, or the online/offline installer with Docker Compose
desc: Harbor is a CNCF container registry with role-based access, vulnerability scanning, image signing and replication.

name: k3s
install: Official install script on a Linux host or VM
desc: k3s is a lightweight, certified Kubernetes distribution packaged as a single binary, ideal for labs, edge devices and Raspberry Pis.

name: Talos Linux
install: ISO, cloud images or the talosctl CLI to create a local cluster
desc: Talos Linux is an immutable, API-managed operating system built only to run Kubernetes, with no SSH or shell.

name: OpenTelemetry Collector
install: Release binaries, Docker image or the Kubernetes operator
desc: The OpenTelemetry Collector receives, processes and exports traces, metrics and logs to any observability backend in a vendor-neutral way.

name: Jaeger
install: Docker image for a single node; Helm chart or operator for Kubernetes
desc: Jaeger is a CNCF distributed-tracing system for following requests across microservices and finding latency bottlenecks.

name: Woodpecker CI
install: Docker Compose or Helm chart
desc: Woodpecker is a lightweight, container-based CI engine that integrates with Gitea, Forgejo, GitHub and GitLab.

name: Kyverno
install: Helm chart
desc: Kyverno is a Kubernetes-native policy engine that validates, mutates and generates resources using policies written in YAML.

name: cert-manager
install: Helm chart or static manifests
desc: cert-manager issues and renews TLS certificates inside Kubernetes from ACME (Let's Encrypt), Vault or private CAs.

name: Cilium
install: cilium CLI or Helm chart
desc: Cilium is an eBPF-based Kubernetes CNI that provides networking, network policy, load balancing and observability through Hubble.

name: Calico
install: Tigera operator manifests or Helm chart
desc: Calico is a widely used Kubernetes CNI and network-policy engine, and a common choice for kubeadm practice clusters.

name: etcd
install: Release binaries; runs as a static pod in kubeadm clusters
desc: etcd is the distributed key-value store that holds all Kubernetes cluster state, and backing it up and restoring it with etcdctl is a classic CKA task.

name: OpenBao
install: Release binaries, packages, Docker image or Helm chart
desc: OpenBao is a Linux Foundation fork of HashiCorp Vault, created after Vault moved to the BUSL, for managing secrets, certificates and encryption keys.

name: Semaphore UI
install: Packages, a single binary or Docker image
desc: Semaphore UI is a web interface for running Ansible playbooks, Terraform and OpenTofu, with scheduling, inventories and access control.

name: Valkey
install: Distribution packages, Docker image or source build
desc: Valkey is a Linux Foundation fork of Redis 7.2, created after Redis left the BSD licence, and works as a drop-in in-memory key-value store.

name: ClickHouse
install: Official install script, packages or Docker image
desc: ClickHouse is a column-oriented database for real-time analytical queries over billions of rows.

name: Apache Cassandra
install: Packages, tarball or Docker image
desc: Apache Cassandra is a distributed wide-column database built for high write throughput and multi-datacentre availability.

name: Apache Kafka
install: Release tarball or Docker image (KRaft mode, no ZooKeeper)
desc: Apache Kafka is a distributed event-streaming platform for durable, high-throughput publish/subscribe messaging and stream processing.

name: RabbitMQ
install: Packages for Linux, a Windows installer, or the Docker image
desc: RabbitMQ is a message broker that supports AMQP, MQTT and STOMP, used to decouple services with queues and routing.

name: InfluxDB
install: Install script, packages or Docker image (InfluxDB 3 Core is the open-source edition)
desc: InfluxDB is a time-series database for metrics, events and sensor data, and its open-source edition is InfluxDB 3 Core.

name: Metabase
install: Docker image or a single JAR
desc: Metabase is a business-intelligence tool that lets people query databases and build dashboards without writing SQL.

name: Apache Superset
install: Docker Compose for evaluation; Helm chart for Kubernetes
desc: Apache Superset is a data exploration and dashboarding platform that connects to most SQL databases.

name: Apache Airflow
install: pip with the published constraints file, Docker Compose or Helm chart
desc: Apache Airflow schedules and monitors data pipelines defined as Python DAGs.

name: Adminer
install: A single PHP file, or the Docker image
desc: Adminer is a single-file PHP database manager for MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, SQL Server and others.

name: phpMyAdmin
install: Distribution package, release archive or Docker image
desc: phpMyAdmin is the long-standing web interface for administering MySQL and MariaDB servers.

name: Supabase
install: Docker Compose bundle for self-hosting, or the hosted service
desc: Supabase is a backend platform built on PostgreSQL with authentication, storage, realtime and auto-generated APIs, available hosted or self-hosted.

name: PocketBase
install: A single executable for Windows, macOS or Linux
desc: PocketBase is a single-file backend with an embedded SQLite database, authentication, file storage and an admin dashboard.
